verdict.rationale: DeepInfra explicitly supports building against the official OpenAI SDK as a drop-in replacement, just by changing the base_url and api_key, requiring no code migration (deepinfra-docs-1, -14, -15, -25, -30). However, all evidence is DeepInfra's own docs; there's no evidence of a dedicated first-party DeepInfra SDK, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK compatibility. Missing for 10: dedicated DeepInfra-branded SDKs (beyond OpenAI-compat), independent developer confirmation that the SDK drop-in works flawlessly in practice.
